methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Vendors without any self-serve USD pricing published (Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty, Kameleoon) are included with quote-only (null) plans to document their pricing opacity. LaunchDarkly Foundation is usage-metered with no flat tier, recorded with monthlyUsd: null and unit rates in notes. Convert prices confirmed on two visits. GrowthBook Pro is per-seat cloud. Statsig Pro is flat monthly with usage overages. Slashdot.org used as secondary corroboration where available. ABsmartly pricing is EUR-denominated with no USD self-serve tier; recorded as quote-only.

vendors.name: Optimizely
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.optimizely.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14 shows 'Request pricing' for all nine products with no published USD figures. No self-serve pricing exists.

plans.name: Web Experimentation
plans.notes: Quote-only. All Optimizely products use customized/annual pricing gated behind sales contact. No self-serve tier published.

plans.name: Feature Experimentation
plans.notes: Quote-only. Annual contracts only per competitor research; no self-serve tier published.

vendors.name: VWO (Visual Website Optimizer)
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://vwo.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Page shows Growth/Pro/Enterprise tier structure across VWO Testing, Feature Experimentation, Insights, Personalize, Rollouts, Mobile Insights, and Pulse products but displays zero USD prices — all require scheduling a demo.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Quote-only. Usage-based billing mentioned but no rate card published.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Quote-only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only.

vendors.name: AB Tasty
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.abtasty.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14 renders JS-only with feature comparison content but zero pricing figures. Page includes 'Get a demo' CTA only.

plans.name: Experimentation & Personalization Platform
plans.notes: Quote-only. No self-serve pricing published. Platform covers Experimentation, Personalization, and Release Management.

vendors.name: Convert Experiences
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.convert.com/pricing/ accessed twice on 2026-06-14. Prices confirmed: Growth $399/mo or $299/mo annual; Pro $599/mo or $420/mo annual. HIPAA badge visible in footer. Corroborated by Slashdot listing showing starting price $399/mo.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Billed annually at $3,588/yr ($299/mo). Month-to-month rate is $399/mo. Includes 100K tested users/month (1.2M/yr), 5 active projects, 10 active domains.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually at $5,040/yr ($420/mo). Month-to-month rate is $599/mo. Includes 100K tested users/month (1.2M/yr), 30 active projects, unlimited active domains.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual plans only. 1M+ tested users/month. Price on request.

vendors.name: Kameleoon
vendors.provenance: Both https://www.kameleoon.com/pricing and https://kameleoon.com/en/pricing returned HTTP 404 on 2026-06-14. No pricing page accessible. No fallback comparison page found with reliable USD figures. All plans recorded as quote-only.

plans.name: Platform
plans.notes: Pricing page returned 404 on access date. Kameleoon covers A/B testing, feature flags, and AI personalization. All pricing is quote-only.

vendors.name: GrowthBook
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.growthbook.io/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Cloud Starter free, Cloud Pro $40/seat/month, Enterprise custom. Self-hosted open source free. HIPAA BAA stated available on Enterprise. No annual discount mentioned for Pro.

plans.name: Cloud Starter
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 3 users. Includes CDN requests up to 1-2M and bandwidth up to 5-20GB included.

plans.name: Cloud Pro
plans.notes: $40/seat/month, up to 50 seats. Overages: CDN requests $10/million; CDN bandwidth $1/GB; Managed Warehouse $0.03/1K events after 2M free. No annual discount published.

plans.name: Cloud Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes HIPAA BAA, SAML/SCIM (Okta, Azure AD), advanced permissions.

plans.name: Self-Hosted Open Source
plans.notes: Free, unlimited users, self-managed. Community support only.

plans.name: Self-Hosted Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes BAA for HIPAA compliance, advanced features, dedicated support.

vendors.name: Statsig
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.statsig.com/pricing accessed twice on 2026-06-14. Developer free at $0, Pro $150/mo flat with 5M events then $0.05/1K overage. Enterprise custom with HIPAA-eligibility (BAA). Corroborated by Slashdot listing showing $0.03 per 1K events as starting unit rate.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free. 2M events/month, unlimited feature flag checks, 50K session replays/month. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $150/mo per project. Includes 5M events/month; overage $0.05 per 1K events. 100K session replays/month. No annual pricing option shown. Applies to one project only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Event or experiment-based contracts. HIPAA-eligibility with BAA. Warehouse-native deployment option. Volume discounts available.

vendors.name: LaunchDarkly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://launchdarkly.com/pricing/ accessed twice on 2026-06-14. Developer free; Foundation usage-based at $10/Service Connection/mo (CodeControl) + $8.33/1K client-side MAU/mo; Enterprise and Guardian custom. HIPAA listed as Enterprise-only feature requiring contact.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free. Unlimited seats. 10M Logs and Traces. 5K AI runs/month. 14 days data retention. No credit card required.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Usage-metered, no flat tier. CodeControl: $10/Service Connection/mo + $8.33/1K client-side MAU/mo. AgentControl: $5/1K AI runs past 5K/mo. Billed yearly. 30 days data retention. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes HIPAA (contact required), release automation, workflows, custom roles. 100 days data retention.

plans.name: Guardian
plans.notes: Quote-only. All Enterprise features plus Release Monitoring, Guardrail Metrics, Automatic Pause/Rollback.
